speaker: Doctor
text: I am ready to begin your assessment. Please tell me the exact time of the rear-end collision and whether you were in the front or back seat at the time of impact.

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acetabular Fracture. The clinical presentation of right groin pain and abnormal leg positioning following a rear-end collision is highly suggestive of a pelvic fracture involving the acetabulum. I will now request an X-ray of the pelvis to confirm the diagnosis.
